svg.title: BOKI character modeling handoff
svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC
Blender shape reference + editable construction notes / Unity 6000.6.7f1 target
M_Deck: rigid body; no suspension geometry.
M_Steering: stem, fork and handlebar assembly.
Grip, headlight and muzzle empties have no render
Use 8–12 radial sides per wheel as a starting
Wheel local axle must match the intended roll
Keep steering pivot independent of wheel axle.
Headlight glass is an opaque bright face; beam is
Boki hands and feet are authored to shared contact
Player ride/boost/jump poses stay in the character
Do not animate the gameplay root or camera pivot.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
